_about: Forever travel facts shared by the planner (tools/travel.js) and the addon (TravelData.lua, generated by tools/gen-travel-data.js). Edit here only. Maps are uiMapIDs, coords 0-1.
_MOUNT: Riding from level 40 (Apprentice, 100g on Forever, first mount included): 60% faster than running. docs/research/world-facts.md
_HOSTILE_SEC: Riding through a town or camp of the other faction (tools/hostile-towns.json): seconds added for the detour, guards and players - possible, fine for PvP, but trouble.

stormwind.name: Stormwind Harbor
stormwind.source: Idrieth Mossgrove, the Auberdine dock NPC: Wowhead Forever npc=276318 (25.4-26.0, 54.2-54.6); warcraft.wiki.gg 26.0, 54.5. The old spot (33.8, 50.4) was a guess, 8 map units inland

_BOATS_races: A 5th entry on a crossing lists the races (or classes: the druids-only hippogryph out of Moonglade) that may use it: the Dalaran-Stormwind portal is Skyborne-only (Method, "how to get to all starting zones", Nov 2026). Other races reach Dalaran overland through Hillsbrad.
_SPELLS: class spells that take you somewhere from anywhere (one way): class, from level, the dock you land at, cast seconds, what you do
